## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Research stage

- Stage / module affected:
- Gate or report affected:

## Methodological impact

- Does this change alter the target or injury-label definition?
- Does it introduce or modify features?
- Are all features available at the prediction timestamp?
- Does it affect temporal splitting, censoring, or recurrent-event handling?
- Does it affect interpretation of model outputs?

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests added or updated.
- [ ] Tests pass locally.
- [ ] Temporal leakage considerations reviewed.
- [ ] Synthetic and real-data results remain clearly separated.
- [ ] Metrics include prevalence and appropriate baselines.
- [ ] Calibration and subgroup limitations considered.
- [ ] Documentation and DECISIONS.md updated where appropriate.

## Evidence

Include commands run, test results, and links to relevant reports. Do not claim tests or real-data experiments were run unless they were actually executed.

## Limitations

Describe remaining uncertainty, known failure modes, and any follow-up work.
